title: I Put the Missing-Soup Photo on the Fridge They Moderated

parts.text: I labeled lentil soup MON LEN and at 12:11 p.m. the container was gone. The fridge policy on the door said: LABEL IT. DON'T EAT LABELS. MODERATORS ENFORCE. Moderator Paige ran the door. I was twenty-nine, desk, holding an empty shelf still. I printed the still, the label scrap in the trash, and Paige's leftover bread in my container. Paige called it a mix-up. Mix-up is a word moderators use when a scrap exists. I taped the photo on the door they moderated. Paige brown-bags. The fridge finally looks like labels, not a buffet.

social.video_title: The moderator's bread was in my lentil container — Part 1/1
social.description: Labeled soup, a trash scrap, a door photo. Has a moderator ever mixed up only your lunch?
